findings.summary: push_scope(id_of(self.schema)) lacks a None check, so schemas without $id (or boolean schemas) push None, which can raise TypeError in urljoin or push a bad scope.

Scopes pushed in __attrs_post_init__ are never popped, so the shared resolver's _scopes_stack grows unbounded and relative $id scopes can leak to siblings, causing relative $ref to resolve against the wrong base URI.
Three blank lines after the new test before `def sorted_errors` trigger flake8 E303.
